title: Can I talk to somebody mid-questions
persona: Rosa Martinez, 40s, nurse from Chicago, rushed, skeptical, asks lots of questions.
goal: Set up a point to point ride while repeatedly asking whether she can speak to a person.
opening_line: Is this a real person or a machine?

turns.caller: Okay. Can I talk to somebody instead? Or can you take a ride?

branches.if_agent: offers to take the trip request
branches.caller: Fine, but will a person actually see it?

turns.caller: I need a car Saturday from the Palmer House hotel to Wrigley Field. Can you do that?
Around 6 in the evening. Is that too late to book?
Four people. Do you have anything that seats four comfortably?
A black SUV is good. Can I pick that?
Rosa Martinez. Do you need a spelling?
My cell is 414-555-0171. Will somebody call me on it?
So that's it? Nobody else I need to talk to?
